message.content: {"summary":"A competent, well-structured report covering all mission elements with STK evidence. Your introduction is strong and persuasive. The main body is weakened by a speculative launch choice, unverified orbital geometry, missing hand calculations and incomplete EOL analysis. Referencing and figure formatting need work. Overall adequate.","criteria":{"C1":"Your Introduction clearly states the mission purpose, need, single-spacecraft justification and users, with literature support. To reach the top of Accomplished, tighten the operator/customer distinction and ensure every claim is referenced.","C2":"All major elements are covered with STK screenshots and access data, but the Vega E choice is speculative, the RAAN/launch-site geometry is not demonstrated, and J2 and delta-v hand calculations are missing. The EOL drag-sail discussion is truncated and conflicts with the earlier manoeuvre mention. Add quantitative support and resolve the inconsistency.","C3":"Your Conclusion summarises the design and acknowledges launch risk, but is largely generic. Reach the next level by stating quantitative outcomes (coverage, contact statistics, deorbit time) and explicit EOL conclusions drawn from your evidence.","C4":"Structure and headings are clear, but references are bare URLs (including Wikipedia), citation formatting is inconsistent, figures lack numbered captions, and there are typos. Move to the next level with a consistent citation style, numbered captions and a proofread."},"next_steps":["Add hand calculations for J2 nodal precession and launch delta-v/payload mass, and demonstrate the launch-site-to-RAAN geometry or justify the plane change.","Complete the EOL analysis with a deorbit time estimate and casualty risk, and resolve the thruster inconsistency between the manoeuvre and EOL sections.","Replace bare-URL and Wikipedia references with properly formatted citations, add numbered figure captions, and proofread for typos and awkward phrasing."]}
